verification.notes: Read live on 2026-10-10 from the Ghana Scholarships Authority's own notice. Confirmed the six participating universities (Taif, Madinah, Jazan, Najran, Tabuk and Fahad Bin Sultan), the three eligibility conditions (Ghanaian citizen resident in Ghana, genuine birth certificate, passport), the nine programme fields, the application route through https://studyinsaudi.sa/en, the publication date of 28 September 2026 and the deadline of 28 October 2026. The notice publishes no monetary value, no benefits itemisation and no language or degree-level requirements, so those fields are null and the Study in Saudi platform itself must be checked for the actual award terms.

applicant_utility.summary: This notice is a pointer, not a full offer: the Ghana Scholarships Authority tells you to apply directly on the Saudi Ministry of Education's Study in Saudi platform, so the real terms, document demands and award conditions live there, not on the Ghana page. The eligibility bar looks light - Ghanaian citizen resident in Ghana, a genuine birth certificate and a passport - but no grades, degree level or language requirement is published, which means the Saudi universities will apply their own admission standards you cannot see from the notice. With a deadline of 28 October 2026 and publication on 28 September 2026, you have about a month, so open the Study in Saudi platform today and read the terms and conditions for the specific university and programme you want before you start. Start your passport immediately if you do not hold one, because it is a stated requirement.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana with a valid passport and birth certificate who want to study in Saudi Arabia at one of the six listed universities and are comfortable applying through a foreign ministry platform.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you hold a valid passport and a genuine birth certificate before starting, since both are named requirements
Open https://studyinsaudi.sa/en and read the eligibility requirements, terms and conditions for each of the six universities before committing

Identify whether your target programme (Technology Management, Business Management, Islamic Economics, Marketing, Engineering, Technology, Medicine, Education or Architecture) is offered at your chosen university and at what level
Prepare the documents each participating Saudi university asks for on the platform, which go beyond the birth certificate and passport
Submit well before 28 October 2026, since the window is only about a month long
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 28 October 2026 deadline in a window that opened only on 28 September 2026
Not holding a valid passport or a genuine birth certificate at the time of application
Applying through the wrong channel - the notice routes applications to Study in Saudi, not to the Ghana portal
Failing the participating university's own unpublished admission standards, since the notice states no grades or degree level
Not reading the terms and conditions on the Saudi platform, which the notice explicitly asks applicants to do
document_audit: The notice names only a birth certificate and a passport, so expect each participating Saudi university to demand additional documents such as transcripts, certificates and medical or visa paperwork on the Study in Saudi platform
Your birth certificate must match the name on your passport exactly, and the notice stresses that it must be genuine
Medical programmes in particular tend to carry extra document and language requirements, so check the university-level conditions rather than relying on the notice
alerts: The window is short: published 28 September 2026, closing 28 October 2026
No funding details are published in the notice, so do not assume a stipend, accommodation or travel cover until you see the terms on the Study in Saudi platform
The programme list does not state degree levels, so confirm whether each programme is bachelor's, master's or other before applying
Applications go through the Saudi platform, so follow-up questions should go there rather than to the Ghana Scholarships Authority
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply directly at https://studyinsaudi.sa/en for your chosen university and programme, reviewing the eligibility requirements and terms and conditions first, and submit before the 28 October 2026 deadline.
